test_output_summary: Created 4 integration tests for memory episode live round-trip. All tests are properly marked with @pytest.mark.integration and skip when RICH_NATS_PASSWORD is not available. All existing unit tests (843 tests) still pass. Code passes ruff linting and mypy strict type checking.
implementation_notes: Created comprehensive integration tests for MemoryEpisodeV1 live round-trip on GB10. The tests demonstrate publish-subscribe patterns using NATSClient.publish_episode() and direct subscription to memory.episode.{project_id}.{episode_type} subjects. The subscriber decodes raw message bodies using MemoryEpisodeV1.model_validate_json(msg.data). Tests cover: (1) basic round-trip, (2) minimal fields only, (3) all optional fields populated, and (4) multiple subscribers receiving the same message. The tests do NOT assert JetStream server-side deduplication and do NOT require a pre-configured JetStream stream, focusing on the basic pub-sub contract.
